spec: Write cron.py with `parse(expr: str) -> dict` and `next_run(expr: str, after: datetime) -> datetime` for 5-field cron expressions (minute 0-59, hour 0-23, day-of-month 1-31, month 1-12, day-of-week 0-6 with 0=Sunday and 7 also meaning Sunday). Each field supports `*`, numbers, ranges `a-b`, steps `*/n`, `a-b/n` and `a/n` (a to the field maximum), and comma lists of these; month names JAN-DEC and day names SUN-SAT in any case, also inside ranges. Macros: @yearly/@annually, @monthly, @weekly, @daily/@midnight, @hourly. parse returns {"minute", "hour", "dom", "month", "dow"} -> sorted lists of ints (dow 7 folded into 0). Day matching follows Vixie cron: if both day-of-month and day-of-week start with something other than `*`, a day matches when EITHER matches; otherwise both must match. next_run returns the first matching minute strictly after `after` (seconds/microseconds zero, keep tzinfo). Raise ValueError for a wrong field count, bad syntax, out-of-range values, step 0, reversed ranges, unknown macros/names, and from next_run when nothing matches within 5 years (e.g. Feb 30). Standard library only.
